front: How is Q5 marked out of 40?
back: 24 marks for content and organisation (AO5), 16 marks for technical accuracy — spelling, punctuation, grammar (AO6).

front: Description or story — which usually gives you more control under time pressure?
back: Description, since it just needs a clear structure to move through rather than a full plot shape.

front: Name two reliable structures for a description.
back: Wide to narrow / far to near, or moving through the senses (sight, sound, smell...).

front: What's a common mistake with narrative under time pressure?
back: Trying to cover too much time/plot — a short, contained moment explored in depth works better.

front: How much time should you spend planning before writing?
back: Roughly 5 minutes — decide description or story, plan a structure, jot a few ambitious vocabulary choices.

front: Why does paragraphing matter in creative writing?
back: A new paragraph should signal a shift in focus, time, or mood — it's part of how you structure the piece.

front: What should you do in the last two minutes of this question?
back: Proofread — SPaG is worth 16 of the 40 marks, more than almost any other single skill on the paper.
